verified_facts.text: Jade Mountain sits above the 600-acre Anse Chastanet beachfront estate in St. Lucia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched majestically above Anse Chastanet’s 600-acre beachfront estate, Jade Mountain Resort in St. Lucia

verified_facts.text: Jade Mountain was designed by its architect-owner, Nick Troubetzkoy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by architect-owner Nick Troubetzkoy

verified_facts.text: Each sanctuary is reached by its own bridge leading to a private infinity pool sanctuary, set among rugged stone columns.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each sanctuary is accessed via individual bridges leading to private infinity pool sanctuaries, with rugged stone columns that soar into the sky.

verified_facts.text: The sanctuaries have unobstructed views of the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
verified_facts.excerpt: These architectural marvels provide unobstructed views of the iconic Pitons and the vast Caribbean Sea—designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

verified_facts.text: Each ensuite infinity pool has a unique design in both colour and shape.
verified_facts.excerpt: the design of each pool is unique both in colour and shape

verified_facts.text: The infinity pools are surfaced entirely in one-of-a-kind glass tiles designed specifically for Jade Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: They have been surfaced entirely in one-of-a-kind glass tiles, which have been specifically designed for JADE MOUNTAIN.

verified_facts.text: The infinity pools are lit at night by fibre optics that can cycle through colours or hold one shade.
verified_facts.excerpt: The infinity pools are equipped with fibre optics to illuminate them at night. Guests have the option of allowing the system to cycle through a range of colours or setting it to one particular shade.

verified_facts.text: The bathrooms have an open floor design that makes them part of the sanctuary.
verified_facts.excerpt: The open floor design allows the bathrooms to become part of the sanctuary experience

verified_facts.text: The chromatherapy whirlpool tubs are for one or two people and sit on a pedestal for panoramic views while bathing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The chromatherapy whirlpool tubs are designed to be enjoyed by one or two persons and they are mounted on a pedestal, allowing the best possible panoramic views whilst bathing.

verified_facts.text: The Jade Mountain Club, wrapped around a colorful infinity pool, caters exclusively to resident guests and serves Chef Allen Susser's Jade Cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wrapped around an infinity pool with a dazzling kaleidoscope of colors, the Jade Mountain Club caters exclusively to resident guests, celebrating James Beard Award winner Chef Allen Susser’s “Jade Cuisine.”

verified_facts.text: The Celestial Terrace, above the Jade Mountain Club, is used for sunset cocktails and stargazing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hovering in space above the Jade Mountain Club is the Celestial Terrace, perfect for sunset cocktails or stargazing.

verified_facts.text: Six in Your Sanctuary is a six-course menu with wine pairing served by your Major Domo in the privacy of your sanctuary.
verified_facts.excerpt: serve you a sensational SIX course menu, with wine pairing, created by our Sommelier and served to you by your Major Domo, in the privacy of your sanctuary

verified_facts.text: Kai en Ciel, the spa at Jade Mountain, has two air-conditioned rooms plus hair, manicure and pedicure stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kai en Ciel (Patois/Creole for house in heaven) is part of Jade Mountain, featuring two air-conditioned rooms in addition to hair, manicure and pedicure stations.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments are available in the privacy of the guest's infinity pool sanctuary or at the Kai en Ciel spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jade Mountain guests can choose from a carefully selected menu of spa treatments available in the privacy of their infinity pool sanctuary or in Jade Mountain’s boutique St. Lucia spa, Kai en Ciel.

verified_facts.text: The spa menu includes classic body and beauty treatments as well as Ayurvedic and holistic services.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer a large and varied menu of both classic body and beauty treatments, as well as Ayurvedic and holistic services.

verified_facts.text: Jade Mountain guests may also use the Kai Belte Spa at Anse Chastanet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additionally, Jade Mountain guests may also enjoy the spa services of Kai Belté Spa at Anse Chastanet.

verified_facts.text: A 10% service charge is added to all spa treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 10% service charge is added in all instances.

verified_facts.text: Yoga classes by resident instructors are non-competitive and open to complete beginners and more advanced students.
verified_facts.excerpt: The classes by our resident Yoga instructors are non-competitive and open to complete beginners as well as to those more advanced.

verified_facts.text: Guests can use an air-conditioned fitness centre on the lower level of the resort, below Kai en Ciel Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of Jade Mountain are welcome to use our boutique, air-conditioned fitness centre located on the lower level of the resort, just below Kai en Ciel Spa.

verified_facts.text: At the resort's Chocolate Lab, chocolate is produced from organically grown cocoa on the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chocoholics will be thrilled with a visit to the resort’s Chocolate Lab, where chocolate is produced from organically grown cocoa right on the property.

verified_facts.text: Guests can visit the resort's Emerald Estate, where organic produce including mango, avocado, guava and cocoa is grown.
verified_facts.excerpt: A visit to the resort’s Emerald Estate, where a variety of organic produce is grown, including mango, avocado, guava, and cocoa, is a delightful exploration.

verified_facts.text: The resort's two natural soft-sand beaches have pristine coral reefs right offshore.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of many of our resort activities are our two beautiful, natural, soft-sand beaches featuring an abundance of pristine coral reefs right offshore.

verified_facts.text: The Anse Chastanet and Anse Mamin beaches are a short walk from Jade Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anse Chastanet and Anse Mamin beaches, accessible on foot (a short walk)

verified_facts.text: The team can arrange a guided hike up the Gros Piton.
verified_facts.excerpt: ask the team to arrange for a guided hike up the Gros Piton

verified_facts.text: Guided walks and hikes led by trained Resort Guides are complimentary, except two that carry a modest transportation surcharge.
verified_facts.excerpt: These exclusive tours, led by trained Resort Guides, are complimentary, except for two that include a modest transportation surcharge.

verified_facts.text: Jade Serenity is a professionally crewed Leopard 45 sailing catamaran offering half-day, full-day and sunset sails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jade Serenity is our professionally crewed Leopard 45 luxury sailing catamaran, a private floating extension of Jade Mountain. Designed for couples and small gatherings, it offers curated half-day, full-day, and sunset-sail journeys

verified_facts.text: The resort is in the south of the island, within easy reach of the rainforest, Botanical Gardens, Drive-In Volcano and Sulphur Springs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Being situated in the southern part of the island, major sightseeing attractions such as the rainforest, Botanical Gardens, Drive-In Volcano, and Sulphur Springs are all within easy reach.

verified_facts.text: Mountain bikes for the resort's custom-designed jungle biking trails are available for rental from Bike St. Lucia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adventure lovers can tackle the resort’s custom-designed jungle biking trails with mountain bikes available for rental from Bike St. Lucia.
